result.intent_description: Teach Genie the top-N by-metric pattern: GROUP BY a dimension, ORDER BY the metric DESC, LIMIT N. Concrete shape uses sales.fact_sales.revenue grouped by sales.fact_sales.region.
result.rationale: Both qids (gs_009, gs_017) miss LIMIT/ORDER BY on revenue per region — the cluster's defining signal.

patch_body.example_question: What are the top 3 regions by total revenue this quarter?
patch_body.example_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales.fact_sales WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
patch_body.usage_guidance: Use when the user asks for top-N entities ranked by a metric within a time window.
